title: Powers' Berto Colón Aka Lorenzo Tejada Reveals His Favorite Episode From Power Book II: Ghost
htmlContent:
In the season finale of Power Book II: Ghost, a lot of action and violence happened in this episode. It also saw Tariq St. Patrick, Brayden Weston, and Effie Morales team up with the whole Tejada family, including Lorenzo Tejada, who was released from prison earlier in season two.

The mission was to turn the tables on Mecca, aka Dante Spears, but the plan that Mecca was a part of was to have Cane Tejada kill Lorenzo like Tariq St Patrick killed Ghost at the end of season six of the Original Power. However, Tariq and Cane were sent in to save his father from Mecca's men, but Cane was not told until he needed to.

In the recent episode of The Crew Has It with Michael Rainey Jr & Gianni Paolo, Berto Colón, who plays Lorenzo Tejada, revealed his favorite episode.

"I gotta say the favorite episode was the f***ing ten because I finally, you know, we got to drive. We got to challenge each other a little bit because there were a lot of bones to pick that Lorenzo had.
